New quarter is almost here, so new features inbound for our web and mobile apps over the next few months:

⏰ Idle and Battery Drain Tracking

You'll finally be able to view a breakdown of what happened while your vehicle was idle (parked) such as sentry, cabin overheat protection, and more. One of the most requested features.

🔋 Battery Health Comparisons

This quarter we launched our battery health breakdown and recently updated it with improved metrics and visuals. Next quarter you'll be able to compare your vehicle to the fleet.

📷 Sentry Alerts (awaiting Apple review)

Receive a notification any time Sentry Model is triggered on your vehicle. We've already completed the backend work for this, and it is awaiting Apple's App Store Review. 

🎶 Media Tracking (Opt-in)

View your vehicle’s listening history during drives or while charging.

📆 Massive Calendar Rework

New weekly and monthly breakdowns, which includes comparisons to prior periods and service alerts (if subscribed to Pro).

🏆 Weekly Leaderboards
Our leaderboards will now include weekly views in addition to our lifetime ones.

More information will be shared when these features are live, and as always, we appreciate your feedback!
